## Astraeus 2.8.1

### New
- **Edge glow in the cover's colors.** The edge glow now takes up to four colors from the cover, each clearly apart from the others, and flows them round the edge. On dark looks it shines in real color instead of fading toward white.
- **Edge glow slider.** Set how far in the edge glow reaches and how bright it is, in Edit fullscreen, under Scene. It works for the Media page's edge glow too.

### Fixed
- Notification banners now sit centered in the banner, and in the Vertical layout their text no longer lands below it. Thanks to @Erorr40 for the fix.
- A song with no artist now has its title centered on the island.
- The problem report now lists the visualizer settings.

> [!NOTE]
> The executable is not code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen may show an "unknown publisher" warning the first time. Click **More info → Run anyway**.
